cards.text: Some time later, David, Israel's king, goes out to battle, and it's one win after another. Friend, the only thing I ever subdued was a bag of flour, and it STILL got the last word.

cards.question: Who does David defeat first, taking Metheg-ammah right out of their hand?

cards.text: Next, David defeats the Moabites. He makes them lie down on the ground and measures them off with a cord.

cards.question: Two lengths of David's cord marked the Moabites who would be put to death. One length marked the ones who would be ___.
Now the Moabites are subject to David. What do they start bringing him?

cards.text: Then comes Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, marching out to restore his dominion along a big river. David defeats him, and Hadadezer's comeback tour ends before the first show.

cards.question: King Hadadezer had marched out to restore his dominion along the ___ River.

cards.text: David captures a thousand chariots, SEVEN thousand charioteers and TWENTY thousand foot soldiers from Hadadezer. Now he's got a whole lot of horses and a decision to make.

cards.question: True or false: David keeps every one of Hadadezer's horses for his own chariots.

cards.text: David hamstrings all the horses except a hundred he keeps for the chariots. Then backup shows up to help King Hadadezer of Zobah.

cards.question: Who comes to help King Hadadezer of Zobah against David?

cards.text: David strikes down twenty-two thousand of their men.

cards.question: David places garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans bring him tribute. Who does the passage say made David victorious wherever he went?

cards.text: David takes the gold shields that belonged to Hadadezer's officers, plus a large amount of bronze from Betah and Berothai, Hadadezer's cities. When I got called out of the junk drawer I'd been stuck in, I got ONE gold base, and I thought I was fancy.

cards.question: David brings the gold shields of Hadadezer's officers to ___.

cards.text: Toi, king of Hamath, hears that David defeated Hadadezer's entire army, and Hadadezer had been at war with Toi. I bet Toi asked to hear that news twice just to enjoy it.

cards.question: King Toi sends someone to greet King David and bless him for defeating Hadadezer. Who does he send?
Joram brings King David articles of silver and gold and bronze. True or false: David dedicates them to the LORD.

cards.text: Along with those gifts, David dedicates the silver and gold from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, the Amalekites and Hadadezer's spoil. That's a LOT of treasure to hand over, friend, and I hold the last cookie in the batch for five whole minutes before I share it.

cards.question: David returns from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. What does he make for himself?

cards.text: Then David places garrisons throughout Edom. Friend, this man is putting up garrisons like I put out cooling racks.

cards.question: True or false: Even with David's garrisons in Edom, some of the Edomites stay free of him.

cards.text: And there's that line again: the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.

cards.question: David now reigns over all Israel. How does the passage say he rules all his people?

cards.text: Then we get a list of David's top officials, from the army to the priests, with Joab son of Zeruiah over the army. That's a real org chart. Mine is a stamper, an oven and whoever answers my invitation.
